name: Utsuro
source:
A beautiful adult older-sister type of person that the protagonist met in an art museum in the past. She has a calm aura, with a clear and beautiful voice, and has a certain adult charm.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2019/10/04/ae/]official website[/url]]
